$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — SemanticProjection. Major version 1. Explicit, reason-carrying human decision that assigns composer roles to OBSERVED design-source locators (issue #23 coordinator fidelity correction): source documents whose layer names/child types do not carry the SLOT-role naming convention (raw text names, button component instances, unlabeled decoration) stay RAW and faithful; this document — reviewed and pinned to the same source revision — is the auditable projection from observed locators to semantic roles. It never invents nodes, content or asset URLs, and every assignment must state its observed reason. Platform-neutral: roles are generic composition vocabulary, never platform identifiers. Version 1.3.0 (issue #25) additively extends the role vocabulary with the two-column composition roles column-primary / column-secondary (which observed slot containers become the native columns, primary first) and inline-media (which observed frames inside a column become native image elements). Version 1.4.0 (issue #28) additively extends the vocabulary with the column-grid roles grid-column (an observed slot container/instance that becomes ONE native column of a multi-column grid line; lines are grouped deterministically from the observed common parent + vertical overlap bands) and grid-caption (a loose text node that composes inside the grid column geometrically containing it, recorded per assignment). Version 1.5.0 (issue #72) additively extends the vocabulary with the carousel and native-listing decisions slide (an observed container that composes as ONE native slide of a slider; carousel intent is not decidable from NodeIR geometry alone, so the role carries the recorded decision), products-grid and products-carousel (an observed container that composes as a native products grid/carousel declaration backed by the platform's catalog widget; the declaration is editable without product data, and any live listing content stays an explicit gap until a verified provider binding exists).
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Semantic Projection

profileId.description: Must equal the profile id of the run that produced the pinned PageStructure.

sourceRevisionId.description: Must equal PageStructure.source.revisionId — a projection is only valid for the observation it reviewed.

notes.description: Free-text context for reviewers; never parsed.

assignments.description: One assignment per source locator. Duplicate locators are a caller error (INPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION); the composer refuses to choose.

sourceLocator.description: The design:// locator of an observed node — exactly as carried by that node's pinned NodeIR evidence.

role.description: Generic composition role. decoration excludes the node AND its whole subtree from content (recorded, never silently dropped); cta resolves its label text from the content manifest; column-primary/column-secondary mark the two observed slot containers that become the native columns (primary first); inline-media marks an observed media frame inside a projected column that composes as a native image element; grid-column (1.4.0) marks an observed slot container/instance that becomes ONE native column of a column-grid shape; grid-caption (1.4.0) marks a loose text node that composes inside the grid column geometrically containing it. slide (1.5.0) marks an observed container that becomes ONE native slide inside a slider shape; products-grid/products-carousel (1.5.0) mark an observed container that becomes a native products grid/carousel declaration (widget-backed, editable default configuration, live listing content remains an explicit gap without a verified provider binding).

reason.description: The observed fact this assignment rests on — a projection without a stated reason is not a reviewable decision.
